BASELINE_INTEGRITY_REPORT.verification_reason: Baseline bytes/file were not supplied in this conversation/package; hash cannot be recomputed here.

checks.definition: input energy - accounted downstream energy = residual/imbalance

ENERGY_ACCOUNTING_CONTRACT.rule: No numerical energy result is reported until actual executable/model/test data are supplied.

FAULT_TEST_CONTRACT.rating_rule: No probability/severity/detectability values may be invented.

INPUT_PROVENANCE_SCHEMA.rule: DERIVED inputs must cite all parent input IDs and derivation method.

qa_controls: no double integration without drift control

derivation_policy.acceleration_to_velocity: single integration with baseline/drift control if used
derivation_policy.velocity_to_position: single integration with initial condition and drift control if used

NEXT_ACTION_ENGINE.selection_rule: return first unsatisfied priority item; do not skip unresolved higher priority blockers

current_snapshot.blocker_description: V4 execution/input-gap closure evidence is not present in the authoritative state; downstream validation cannot be claimed.
current_snapshot.required_input: V4 execution record + input-gap closure manifest + evidence hashes
current_snapshot.dependency: V4 execution environment and complete inputs
current_snapshot.unlock_condition: V4 evidence package passes evidence integrity gate

current_snapshot.blocker_description: Authoritative state says V4 has input gaps; exact missing inputs must be enumerated and closed.
current_snapshot.required_input: machine-readable V4 input-gap list with source/unit/provenance and closure state

orphan_rules: Every requirement_id must resolve to at least one function, parameter, interface, model, test, evidence, and acceptance criterion.
Every parameter/interface/model/test/evidence ID must be referenced by at least one requirement or dependency.
Unreferenced entities are ORPHAN and cause the owning readiness gate to FAIL.

V4_DEPENDENCY_CONTRACT.downstream_consumption_rule: V5/V6/V7 MUST reject V4 results with BLOCKED, INVALID, or UNVERIFIED status.

V5_EXECUTION_CONTRACT.execution_rule: No critical field may be silently defaulted. Missing critical inputs keep V5_MODEL_READY=FAIL.

fields.name: occupant_representation
fields.description: representation type and implementation identity; NULL only when blocked

fields.name: anthropometry_source
fields.description: authoritative source identifier; no guessed anthropometry

fields.name: CG
fields.description: CG vector in declared frame when supplied

fields.name: inertia
fields.description: mass inertia tensor in declared frame when supplied

fields.name: joint_definitions
fields.description: joint list with type, parent, child, axes, limits if applicable

fields.name: initial_velocity
fields.description: velocity state with frame and units

readiness_gate.expression: ALL(required field.state IN {READY,MEASURED,VALIDATED} AND required field has source+provenance+unit where applicable)

forbidden_actions: consume V4 outputs with status BLOCKED/INVALID/UNVERIFIED

data_quality_rules: No MEASURED or VALIDATED state without raw-data provenance.
No VALIDATED state without calibration and synchronization evidence.
Reject duplicate channel names unless explicitly versioned.
Coordinate system and sign convention must be declared.

V7_CORRELATION_ENGINE_CONTRACT.acceptance_policy: No threshold may be invented. Unsourced thresholds must remain THRESHOLD_REQUIRED=TRUE and cannot produce PASS.
